test_title: PYST 47: RRB Group D - Reasoning (Held On: 17 Dec, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question:
Akshay starts from Point M and drives 8 km towards the east. He then takes a right turn, drives 5 km, turns left and drives 3 km. He then takes a right turn and drives 7 km. He then takes a right turn and drives 11 km. He takes a final right turn, drives 5 km and stops at Point P. How far(shortest distance) and in which direction is Point P with respect to Point M?

(All turns are 90° turns only unless specified.)
solution:
The logic followed here is:

Given:

Point M is taken as origin (0, 0)

8 km East

5 km South

3 km East

7 km South

11 km West

5 km North

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6077f0ede2e4cfb83487e09fdafceddb5a820f1e881ea150ac97912154cceb11.png] 

So, 7 km South of Point M.

Hence, the correct answer is **Option 3**.
